# dtrpg-metadata

This adds a new metadata provider for calibre-web which will look for information on DriveThruRPG.com

Add it to the `calibre-web` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-dtrpg-metadata
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-dtrpg-metadata|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

# Calibre-web - DriveThruRPG Metadata Provider

After installing, DriveThruRPG will be an option when pulling in metadata about a book.

In `calibre-web` docker arguments, set an environment variable `DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-dtrpg-metadata` to enable.

such as `DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-calibre|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-dtrpg-metadata`

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/calibre-web-dtrpg-metadata/
